title: Paul McCartney live: Echo Arena, Liverpool | 2018
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Echo Arena in Liverpool, England, on 12 December 2018.

It was the 16th show of the Freshen Up Tour, which lasted for 39 dates between September 2018 and July 2019. This concert was seen by 9,032 fans.

There’s nothing like performing in front of your home crowd, especially when it’s been a while. I can’t wait to finish the year on such a high by partying in Liverpool, Glasgow and London. We’ve freshened up the show since our last time round and we are excited to get to play some of our new songs along side some of the favourites.
Paul McCartney
paulmccartney.com

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

McCartney previously performed at the Echo Arena on 20 December 2011 during the On The Run Tour, and 28 May 2015 during the Out There Tour.
